data.name: Nazeefah
data.gender_notes: Nazeefah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nazafa', meaning 'to purify', 'to cleanse'. This name symbolizes the liberation and purification of one's soul. In Islamic tradition, it represents the journey towards spiritual enlightenment and freedom from worldly desires and material attachments. The name Nazeefah carries the meaning “Liberated, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazeefah usually hope their child will grow to embody liberated, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual journey towards enlightenment and liberation from material attachments in Islam.
data.etymology: Nazeefah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberated, Free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazeefah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
